Why would someone buy a product for PKR 3,500 when they can find something similar for PKR 500 on Daraz?

The answer is simple: customers don't just pay for the product. They pay for quality, trust, reliability, and the overall buying experience.

A strong brand offers genuine products, proper packaging, reliable delivery, and customer support. Plus, good content and product presentation can create demand and encourage impulse purchases.

Stop competing only on price. Give customers a reason to choose your brand.

#EcommercePakistan #BrandBuilding #Shopify #CustomerExperience #PerformanceMarketing

Start creating organic content, showcase your outfits, styling ideas, product details, and different ways to wear your collections.

Don't wait for paid ads to bring customers. Create content in volume, test different formats, and understand what your audience actually likes.

Once you find Reels that get strong views and engagement, use those winning creatives in your Meta Ads campaigns to reach more potential customers and drive sales.

Build attention organically, then scale what works.
